stories.summary: Sam Rowlands MS, who represents Flintshire and Wrexham in the Senedd, has been named chair of a new cross-party group on palliative and hospice care. stories.title: police HGV cab catches drivers on their phones on the A55
stories.summary: North Wales Police stopped more than 30 vehicles on the A55, A483 and A494 earlier this month as part of Operation Tramline. stories.summary: A Reform Senedd Member has accused the health minister of lying during a debate on the health visitor pay dispute. James Evans, who is shadow minister for health and prevention, hit out at Mabon ap Gwynfor on Wednesday 16 September. stories.title: Welsh NHS waiting lists rise again as minister pledges planned care ‘reset’
stories.summary: The health minister has pledged to reset how “planned care is delivered” after NHS waiting lists rose for the fourth month in a row. Provisional data released today shows that in July there were just under 709,700 referral to treatment (RTT) patient pathways waiting to start treatment – an increase of around 11,300 since June.
